mainTopic: Trying to prove from other cases of טומאה that the impure loaf being discussed can disqualify תרומה. Each proposed source is pushed back with a מה ל- argument.
overview: The גמרא is searching for a source that the impure loaf, which is food, can disqualify תרומה. It tries a טבול יום, but he comes from a type that can include an אב הטומאה. It then tries a כלי חרש, but it has the special power of airspace. Each source cancels the other's weak point, so the גמרא combines them through their common feature (הצד השוה) to prove the law by קל וחומר. The later generation rejects this because both sources have some strict side, while רבן יוחנן בן זכאי does not accept that objection. Next, a ברייתא brings רבי יוסי's קל וחומר from a מחוסר כיפורים that קודש has a fourth level of impurity, and the גמרא shows from ויקרא 7:19 that the third level comes from the תורה. רבי יוחנן challenges the קל וחומר with food touched by a טבול יום, based on a three-way ברייתא between אבא שאול, רבי מאיר and the חכמים. רב פפא asks whether רבי יוסי might hold like אבא שאול. The גמרא answers that if he did, he would have used an easier קל וחומר, and that argument continues on the next amud.

steps.title: Learning from a person who immersed after touching a creeping animal
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא finishes its suggestion that the law of the loaf can be learned from a טבול יום who became impure through a שרץ.
steps.simpleTranslation: [Let us learn it] from a טבול יום who became impure through a שרץ!
steps.whatsHappening: This line finishes a sentence that began before this section. The גמרא suggests a source: a person who became impure by touching a שרץ, immersed, and is waiting for nightfall.
steps.deeperAnalysis: That person was never an אב הטומאה himself. He only picked up a lower level of impurity from touching the שרץ. Even so, he disqualifies תרומה if he touches it. So the גמרא suggests: if he can do that, the loaf under discussion should be able to as well.

keyTerms.meaning: Someone who immersed today but must wait until nightfall to be fully pure.
A creeping animal whose carcass gives off impurity.
The portion of produce given to a כהן, which must be eaten in purity.

steps.confusionAlert: This line is the end of a sentence that started earlier. On its own it looks like a fragment, but it is the source the גמרא is proposing.

phrases.english: From one who immersed that day after becoming impure through a creeping animal!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Finishes the source proposal that began before this section.
steps.raayaObject: That the impure loaf under discussion disqualifies תרומה.
steps.raayaSupportSource: A טבול יום who became impure through a שרץ: he was never an אב הטומאה, yet he disqualifies תרומה.

steps.title: The טבול יום case is stronger than the loaf
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא rejects the proof. People and utensils can be an אב הטומאה, so they are a stronger category than food.
steps.simpleTranslation: What is special about a טבול יום of a שרץ? Within his type, there can be an אב הטומאה!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא pushes back on the proposed source. It points out a way the טבול יום is 'stronger' than the loaf.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Within the category of people and utensils, some can be an אב הטומאה, the highest level of impurity. Food, like the loaf, can never be an אב הטומאה. So maybe the טבול יום disqualifies תרומה only because his category is stronger. That means we cannot learn the weaker loaf from him.

keyTerms.meaning: 'What is special about…'. This is the standard way to point out a difference that breaks a comparison.
'For it is…'. This introduces the special feature.
Within its type or category.
A primary source of impurity.

phrases.english: What is unique about one who immersed that day after a creeping animal
that within its type there is a primary source of impurity!
phrases.notes: People and utensils can sometimes be an אב הטומאה; food never can.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rejects the source proposed in step 1.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: Only the proof from טבול יום, not the law of the loaf itself.
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: The טבול יום belongs to a category that can include an אב הטומאה, which makes it stronger than food.

steps.title: An earthenware vessel shows the difference does not matter
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא answers the rejection by pointing to a כלי חרש. It can never become an אב הטומאה, yet it still disqualifies תרומה.
steps.simpleTranslation: A כלי חרש will prove it.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a new case to cancel the difference raised in step 2.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A כלי חרש can never be an אב הטומאה, so in that respect it is like food. Even so, an impure כלי חרש disqualifies תרומה. This shows that being in a category with an אב הטומאה is not what gives the power to disqualify.

keyTerms.meaning: An earthenware (clay) vessel.
'Will prove'. It brings a case that shows a supposed difference does not matter.

phrases.english: An earthenware vessel will prove it.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Defends the derivation against the rejection in step 2.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Counter-example (יוכיח) that cancels the proposed difference.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: Only something whose category can be an אב הטומאה can disqualify תרומה.
steps.terutzMaskana: A כלי חרש is never an אב הטומאה yet disqualifies תרומה, so that feature is not the reason.

steps.title: The earthenware vessel has its own special power
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא rejects the כלי חרש proof too. A כלי חרש has the special ability to give and receive impurity through its airspace.
steps.simpleTranslation: What is special about a כלי חרש? It makes things impure through its airspace!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא finds a new difference, this time between the כלי חרש and the loaf.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A כלי חרש can pass on or pick up impurity without direct touching, just through the air inside it. The loaf has no such power. So the כלי חרש is also 'stronger' than the loaf, and the proof from it fails.

keyTerms.meaning: Makes something impure.
Airspace, here meaning the inside of the vessel.

steps.whatToRemember: Each source is knocked down by finding a feature that makes it stronger than the loaf: first the אב הטומאה category of the טבול יום, then the airspace power of the כלי חרש.

phrases.english: What is unique about an earthenware vessel?
It renders impure through its airspace!
phrases.notes: Something inside the clay vessel's space can become impure, or make it impure, without touching its walls.

steps.triggerLanguage: מָה לִכְלִי חֶרֶשׂ שֶׁכֵּן מְטַמֵּא מֵאֲוִירוֹ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rejects the counter-example offered in step 3.
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: A כלי חרש has the unique power to transmit and receive impurity through its airspace, which the loaf lacks.

steps.title: The person who immersed today proves airspace does not matter
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא answers the airspace objection. A טבול יום has no airspace power, yet he still disqualifies תרומה.
steps.simpleTranslation: A person who immersed today can prove it.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the rejection from Step 4. It points back to the טבול יום, who disqualifies תרומה even though he has no special airspace power.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Step 4 said a כלי חרש is special because it passes on impurity through its airspace. A טבול יום only passes on impurity by touching, and he still disqualifies תרומה. So airspace cannot be the real reason a כלי חרש disqualifies תרומה.

keyTerms.meaning: Someone who immersed today but must wait until nightfall to be fully pure
Will prove (a counter-example that defeats an objection)
Earthenware vessel (written in our text as כלי חרש)

steps.confusionAlert: Don't think we are back to proving from טבול יום alone. He was already rejected in Step 2. Here he only cancels the airspace objection, which sets up combining the two sources.

phrases.english: One who immersed that day will prove it.
phrases.notes: He disqualifies תרומה only by touching it, with no airspace power, so airspace can't be what matters.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Defeats the airspace rejection of the כלי חרש source.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: A כלי חרש disqualifies תרומה only because of its airspace power.
steps.terutzMaskana: טבול יום has no airspace power and still disqualifies תרומה, so airspace is not the deciding factor.

steps.title: Combining both sources to prove the law of the loaf
steps.stepSummary: Each source has its own weak point, but their common feature proves that a שני loaf disqualifies תרומה, all the more so.
steps.simpleTranslation: The argument goes back to the start. This case is not like that one, and that case is not like this one. What they share is that they leave חולין alone but disqualify תרומה. All the more so a שני loaf, which is itself disqualified even as חולין, should disqualify תרומה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא now builds the full proof by combining טבול יום and כלי חרש. Neither works alone, but what they share proves the law of the loaf.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Each source was rejected because of its own special feature. The טבול יום belongs to a category (people and utensils) that can include an אב הטומאה, and a כלי חרש has airspace power, but neither feature belongs to both. What both share is that they do not make חולין impure yet still disqualify תרומה. A שני loaf is stricter than both, since it is itself impure even as חולין, so by קל וחומר it disqualifies תרומה.

keyTerms.meaning: The argument goes back to its starting point
The feature of this case is not like the feature of that one
The common feature shared by two sources
All the more so (a קל וחומר)
A loaf with second-degree impurity

steps.whyThisMatters: This is how רבן יוחנן בן זכאי showed that a שלישי in תרומה is impure, which is the point the משנה was discussing.

phrases.english: And the argument returns to its start.
The aspect of this is not like the aspect of that,
and the aspect of that is not like the aspect of this.
The common feature between them
is that they are permitted with non-sacred food, but disqualify תרומה:
phrases.notes: 'Permitted' means they don't make ordinary food impure when they touch it.

phrases.english: all the more so a loaf of second degree
which is disqualified even as non-sacred food,
should disqualify תרומה.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְחוֹזֵר הַדִּין. לֹא רְאִי זֶה כִּרְאִי זֶה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: With each source's objection neutralized by the other, the גמרא combines them into a צד השוה proof.
steps.raayaObject: A שני loaf disqualifies תרומה, making it a שלישי.
steps.raayaSupportSource: The shared feature of טבול יום and כלי חרש: they leave חולין pure but disqualify תרומה.

steps.title: The later generation's objection: both sources are strict
steps.stepSummary: The later generation rejects the combined proof because both sources have some strict feature that a loaf lacks.
steps.simpleTranslation: And the other generation objects: what is special about their common feature? That they each have a strict side.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא explains how the 'other generation' from the משנה would reject this proof. They say both sources have something strict about them.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The טבול יום belongs to a category that can include an אב הטומאה, and a כלי חרש has airspace power. Even though the strict feature is different in each, both sources are strict in some way and a loaf is not. So the later generation says you cannot learn the loaf from them, and a שלישי in תרומה would stay pure.

keyTerms.meaning: Another (later) generation, the one רבן יוחנן בן זכאי predicted would declare it pure
Refutes / objects
A strict aspect

phrases.english: And another generation refutes:
phrases.notes: This is the later generation the משנה said would declare a שלישי loaf pure.

phrases.english: What is special about their common feature?
That they have a strict aspect.
phrases.notes: Each has a different strict side: for the טבול יום, his type can include an אב הטומאה; for the כלי חרש, its airspace.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Attacks the צד השוה proof just built.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: The whole combined proof from טבול יום and כלי חרש.
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: Both sources have a strict aspect (even if different ones) that the loaf lacks.

steps.title: Why רבן יוחנן בן זכאי's proof still stands for him
steps.stepSummary: רבן יוחנן בן זכאי does not accept the objection that both sources have a strict side, so his proof holds.
steps.simpleTranslation: And רבן יוחנן בן זכאי does not object based on a strict aspect.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא explains the disagreement. רבן יוחנן בן זכאי does not accept the 'strict aspect' objection, so for him the proof works.
steps.deeperAnalysis: For רבן יוחנן בן זכאי, a strict feature only breaks a צד השוה if both sources share the same one. Here each source's strict feature is different, so it does not count. That is why he held the loaf disqualifies תרומה, while the later generation, who accept this objection, have no source and call it pure.

keyTerms.meaning: The תנא who predicted the later generation's ruling
Does not refute (does not accept that objection)

steps.whatToRemember: Both sides agree on the proof's structure. They argue only about whether 'each source has some strict side' is enough to break a צד השוה. רבן יוחנן בן זכאי says no, so a שלישי in תרומה is impure. The later generation says yes, so they call it pure.
steps.confusionAlert: Don't read this as רבן יוחנן בן זכאי holding the loaf pure. Because he rejects the objection, his proof stands and the שני loaf does disqualify תרומה.

phrases.english: And רבן יוחנן בן זכאי
does not refute with a strict aspect.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְרַבָּן יוֹחָנָן בֶּן זַכַּאי, צַד חָמוּר לָא פָּרֵיךְ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Explains why the objection of Step 7 did not move רבן יוחנן בן זכאי.
steps.maskanaFinalTakeaway: The disagreement depends on whether a 'strict aspect' that differs in each source can refute a צד השוה. רבן יוחנן בן זכאי says it cannot, so for him a שני loaf disqualifies תרומה.

steps.title: רבי יוסי asks for the source of a fourth degree in sacred food
steps.stepSummary: A ברייתא quotes רבי יוסי asking how we know that קודש is disqualified even at the fourth level of impurity.
steps.simpleTranslation: It was taught in a ברייתא: רבי יוסי said: How do we know that קודש at the fourth level of impurity is disqualified?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a new ברייתא. In it, רבי יוסי asks for a source that a רביעי in קודש is disqualified. This is a setup line, and the next step will give his answer.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Up to now we have dealt with תרומה, which stops at the third level. רבי יוסי now asks about קודש, which is more sensitive and goes one level further, to a fourth level. He wants to know what that extra level is based on.

keyTerms.meaning: It was taught (in a ברייתא)
An item at the fourth level of impurity
Sacred food, such as meat of a קרבן
Disqualified: it may not be eaten, but it does not pass impurity on
From where do we know?

steps.confusionAlert: פסול does not mean fully טמא. A רביעי in קודש cannot be eaten, but it does not make anything else impure. That is why it is the last level.

phrases.english: It was taught: Rabbi Yosei said:
From where do we know that a fourth degree in sacred food is disqualified?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves from the discussion of a שלישי in תרומה to a new ברייתא about a רביעי in קודש.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: The source for the rule that a רביעי in קודש is disqualified.

steps.title: A logical argument from one who still lacks atonement
steps.stepSummary: רבי יוסי argues: a מחוסר כיפורים may eat תרומה yet still disqualifies קודש, so a שלישי, which is already invalid for תרומה, should surely make a רביעי in קודש.
steps.simpleTranslation: It is a logical argument. A person who still lacks atonement is allowed to eat תרומה, yet he disqualifies קודש. A שלישי is already disqualified for תרומה. Is it not logical that it should make a רביעי in קודש?
steps.whatsHappening: רבי יוסי answers his own question with a קל וחומר, a 'how much more so' argument.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A מחוסר כיפורים is a person like a זב who has immersed but has not yet brought his קרבן. He is pure enough for תרומה, so he is the 'lighter' case, yet he still disqualifies קודש. A שלישי is the 'stricter' case, because it already makes תרומה unfit. So it should certainly affect קודש and create a רביעי.

keyTerms.meaning: It is a logical argument
Someone who has immersed but has not yet brought his atonement קרבן
An item at the third level of impurity
The portion of produce given to a כהן

phrases.english: And it is a logical argument:
Just as one who is lacking atonement,
who is permitted to eat תרומה,
disqualifies sacred food;
a third degree, which is already disqualifying with תרומה,
is it not logical
that it should make a fourth degree in sacred food?

steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: A קל וחומר from a מחוסר כיפורים: if the lighter case disqualifies קודש, the stricter שלישי certainly makes a רביעי in קודש.

steps.title: Third degree from the Torah, fourth degree from the logical argument
steps.stepSummary: The ברייתא sums up: a שלישי in קודש is learned from the תורה, and a רביעי is learned from the קל וחומר.
steps.simpleTranslation: So we have learned that a שלישי in קודש comes from the תורה, and a רביעי comes from the קל וחומר.
steps.whatsHappening: The ברייתא wraps up by naming two sources: one for the third level and one for the fourth.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The קל וחומר only works if we already know that a שלישי in קודש is real, since the argument is built on a שלישי. So the ברייתא says the third level has its own source in the תורה. The fourth level is then built on top of it by logic.

keyTerms.meaning: A 'how much more so' argument from a lighter case to a stricter one
From a פסוק in the תורה
And we have learned

phrases.english: And we have learned a third degree for sacred food from the Torah,
and a fourth degree from the a fortiori argument.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Sums up the ברייתא after the קל וחומר.
steps.maskanaFinalTakeaway: A שלישי in קודש comes from the תורה, and a רביעי in קודש comes from רבי יוסי's קל וחומר.

steps.title: Where does the Torah teach a third degree in sacred food?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks for the פסוק behind the ברייתא's claim that a שלישי in קודש comes from the תורה.
steps.simpleTranslation: A שלישי in קודש from the תורה: where do we learn this?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks the ברייתא to show its source for the third level in קודש. This sets up the answer in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The ברייתא said the third level comes from the תורה but did not quote a פסוק. Since the whole קל וחומר stands on that third level, the גמרא needs to make sure it really has a source.

keyTerms.meaning: From where do we know this?

phrases.english: A third degree for sacred food from the Torah, from where do we know it?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Asks for the source of the first half of the ברייתא's summary.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: The פסוק showing that a שלישי in קודש is disqualified.

steps.title: The verse about meat that touches anything impure
steps.stepSummary: The פסוק says meat that touches anything impure may not be eaten. That includes meat that touched a שני, which becomes a שלישי, so a שלישי in קודש is disqualified by the תורה.
steps.simpleTranslation: As it is written: "And the meat that touches anything impure shall not be eaten." Are we not talking even about meat that touched a שני? And the תורה says, "it shall not be eaten."
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers with a פסוק about קרבן meat. The פסוק covers even meat that touched a שני.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The words בכל טמא ('anything impure') are broad, so they include an item at the second level. Meat that touches a שני becomes a שלישי. Since the תורה says this meat may not be eaten, a שלישי in קודש is disqualified straight from the תורה.

keyTerms.meaning: As it is written
Are we not dealing with...? (it obviously includes this case)
An item at the second level of impurity
The Merciful One, meaning the תורה

phrases.english: As it is written:
"And the meat that touches anything impure
shall not be eaten."
Are we not dealing even with meat that touched a second degree?
And the Merciful One says, "it shall not be eaten."

steps.triggerLanguage: דִּכְתִיב: וְהַבָּשָׂר אֲשֶׁר יִגַּע בְּכׇל טָמֵא לֹא יֵאָכֵל
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the question of step 12 with a פסוק.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: ויקרא 7:19 forbids meat that touched any impure thing, including a שני, so meat at the third level is disqualified by the תורה.

steps.title: The fourth degree comes from the logical argument already stated
steps.stepSummary: With the שלישי established from the פסוק, the רביעי in קודש follows from רבי יוסי's קל וחומר, as already explained.
steps.simpleTranslation: And a רביעי comes from the קל וחומר, as we said.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא closes the loop. The third level comes from the פסוק, and the fourth level comes from רבי יוסי's קל וחומר.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Now both parts of the ברייתא's summary have a clear source. The פסוק secures the שלישי. The קל וחומר from a מחוסר כיפורים then carries the impurity one more step, to a רביעי.

keyTerms.meaning: As we said earlier

steps.whatToRemember: In קודש, impurity reaches four levels. The third level comes straight from the תורה (ויקרא 7:19). The fourth level comes from רבי יוסי's קל וחומר: if a מחוסר כיפורים, who may eat תרומה, still disqualifies קודש, then surely a שלישי does.

phrases.english: A fourth degree comes from the a fortiori argument, as we said.
phrases.notes: This points back to רבי יוסי's קל וחומר from someone who still lacks atonement.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Uses the פסוק from step 13 to complete the ברייתא's two sources.
steps.maskanaFinalTakeaway: The שלישי in קודש is from the תורה, and the רביעי is from the קל וחומר, so both levels in קודש are fully sourced.

steps.title: רבי יוחנן finds a counter-example to the קל וחומר
steps.stepSummary: רבי יוחנן says רבי יוסי's קל וחומר fails, because food made impure by a טבול יום is invalid for תרומה but does not make a רביעי in קודש.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי יוחנן said: I don't understand the reasoning of the distinguished רבי יוסי, because the answer against it is right next to it. Food that became impure from a טבול יום proves the point: it is invalid for תרומה, yet it does not make a fourth level in קודש.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי יוחנן attacks רבי יוסי's קל וחומר by pointing to a case where being invalid for תרומה does NOT lead to a רביעי in קודש.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי יוסי argued that anything invalid for תרומה should surely create a רביעי in קודש. רבי יוחנן brings food touched by a טבול יום: it is invalid for תרומה, yet it does not make a רביעי in קודש. One counter-example is enough to break the קל וחומר.

keyTerms.meaning: Someone who immersed in a מקוה today but must wait for sunset to become fully pure
A title of honor, 'the distinguished one', used here for רבי יוסי
Its answer is right beside it: the argument can be refuted easily
Will prove: a case that shows the argument is wrong

phrases.english: Rabbi Yochanan says:

phrases.aramaic: טַעַם בְּרִיבִּי אֵינִי יוֹדֵעַ מָה הוּא,
phrases.english: The reasoning of the distinguished one, I do not know what it is,
phrases.notes: "The distinguished one" is רבי יוסי, the one who made the קל וחומר.

phrases.english: for the answer against it is right beside it:

phrases.aramaic: אוֹכֶל הַבָּא מֵחֲמַת טְבוּל יוֹם יוֹכִיחַ,
phrases.english: food that comes because of a טבול יום will prove it,
for it is invalid for תרומה
and yet it does not make a fourth in קודש.

steps.triggerLanguage: טַעַם בְּרִיבִּי אֵינִי יוֹדֵעַ מָה הוּא, שֶׁהֲרֵי תְּשׁוּבָתוֹ בְּצִדּוֹ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Attacks the קל וחומר of רבי יוסי that step 14 relied on for the רביעי in קודש.
steps.kashyaTarget: רבי יוסי's קל וחומר: whatever is invalid for תרומה should make a רביעי in קודש.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: Counter-example: food from a טבול יום is invalid for תרומה but does not make a רביעי in קודש, so the קל וחומר is broken.

steps.title: A ברייתא shows how far a טבול יום spreads impurity to קודש
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא brings a ברייתא with three opinions; the חכמים say a טבול יום only disqualifies קודש, which backs up רבי יוחנן's claim.
steps.simpleTranslation: As it was taught: אבא שאול says a טבול יום counts as a 'first level' for קודש: he makes two things impure and disqualifies a third. רבי מאיר says he makes one thing impure and disqualifies one more. The חכמים say: just as he only disqualifies תרומה foods and drinks, so too he only disqualifies קודש foods and drinks.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings the source for רבי יוחנן's claim that food from a טבול יום does not make a רביעי in קודש.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The proof comes from the חכמים: a טבול יום only disqualifies קודש, so the food he touches cannot pass impurity any further and never makes a רביעי. אבא שאול and רבי מאיר disagree and let the impurity spread further. רבי יוחנן is assuming רבי יוסי holds like the חכמים.

keyTerms.meaning: A 'first', meaning first-level impurity
To make impure, so that it can pass impurity on
To disqualify, making it unfit without letting it pass impurity on
Liquids

steps.confusionAlert: Keep לְטַמֵּא and לִפְסוֹל apart: 'impure' means it can spread the impurity further, while 'disqualified' means it is unfit but the chain stops there.

phrases.english: As it is taught: Abba Shaul says:
A טבול יום is a "first" for קודש,
to make two impure and to disqualify one.
Rabbi Meir says:
He makes one impure and disqualifies one.
And the Sages say:

phrases.aramaic: כְּשֵׁם שֶׁפּוֹסֵל אוֹכְלֵי תְרוּמָה וּמַשְׁקֵי תְרוּמָה
phrases.english: Just as he disqualifies foods of תרומה and liquids of תרומה

phrases.aramaic: כָּךְ פּוֹסֵל אוֹכְלֵי קוֹדֶשׁ וּמַשְׁקֵי קוֹדֶשׁ!
phrases.english: so he disqualifies foods of קודש and liquids of קודש!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives the source for the counter-example in step 15.
steps.raayaObject: That food from a טבול יום does not make a רביעי in קודש.
steps.raayaSupportSource: The opinion of the חכמים in the ברייתא: a טבול יום only disqualifies קודש, just like תרומה.

steps.title: רב פפא: maybe רבי יוסי holds like אבא שאול
steps.stepSummary: רב פפא asks why we assume רבי יוסי holds like the חכמים; if he holds like אבא שאול, food from a טבול יום does make a רביעי in קודש and the counter-proof fails.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב פפא objected: How do we know רבי יוסי holds like the חכמים? Maybe he holds like אבא שאול, who says a טבול יום makes two things impure and disqualifies a third!
steps.whatsHappening: רב פפא pushes back on רבי יוחנן, saying the counter-example only works if רבי יוסי agrees with the חכמים.
steps.deeperAnalysis: According to אבא שאול, a טבול יום is like a 'first' for קודש, so the impurity goes all the way to a fourth level in קודש. If רבי יוסי holds this way, food from a טבול יום really does make a רביעי, and it no longer disproves his קל וחומר. רבי יוחנן's challenge depends on an assumption that רב פפא questions.

keyTerms.meaning: Objects to it, a strong challenge to a statement
From where do we know?
Perhaps
He holds that way

phrases.english: Rav Pappa objects to it:
From where do we know that Rabbi Yosei
holds like the Rabbis?
Perhaps he holds like Abba Shaul,
who says to make two impure and to disqualify one!
phrases.notes: With אבא שאול, the chain in קודש reaches a fourth level, so the food from the טבול יום would make a רביעי after all.

steps.triggerLanguage: מַתְקֵיף לַהּ רַב פָּפָּא: מִמַּאי דְּרַבִּי יוֹסֵי כְּרַבָּנַן סְבִירָא לֵיהּ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges the hidden assumption behind steps 15 and 16, that רבי יוסי holds like the חכמים.
steps.kashyaTarget: רבי יוחנן's counter-example from food made impure by a טבול יום.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: If רבי יוסי holds like אבא שאול, food from a טבול יום does make a רביעי in קודש, so it is not a counter-example to his קל וחומר.

steps.title: If he held like אבא שאול, he would have used the טבול יום case
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא answers רב פפא: had רבי יוסי held like אבא שאול, he would have proven a רביעי in קודש from food touched by a טבול יום.
steps.simpleTranslation: If you think רבי יוסי holds like אבא שאול, then he should have brought his proof for a fourth level in קודש from food that became impure through a טבול יום.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers רב פפא's question. It argues that רבי יוסי does not hold like אבא שאול, because then he would have argued differently.
steps.deeperAnalysis: According to אבא שאול, food touched by a טבול יום already makes a רביעי in קודש. That would give רבי יוסי a ready-made starting point for his proof. The גמרא's point is that since he did not use it, he seems to hold like the חכמים, which would let רבי יוחנן's counter-proof stand. The discussion continues on the next amud, so this is not yet the final word.

keyTerms.meaning: If it would enter your mind, meaning 'if you were to think'
The תנא who holds that a טבול יום himself counts as a תחילה (first level) for קודש, so he makes two items impure and disqualifies a third
Let him bring it, meaning he should have derived it from there
A fourth level of impurity, which exists only for sacred food

steps.confusionAlert: This is not saying רבי יוסי agrees with אבא שאול. It is the opposite: since רבי יוסי did not argue this way, he must not hold like אבא שאול.

phrases.english: If it enters your mind
that he holds like Abba Shaul,
phrases.notes: 'He' is רבי יוסי, whose קל וחומר we have been discussing.

phrases.english: let him bring proof for a fourth degree in sacred food
from food that became impure through one who immersed that day.

steps.triggerLanguage: אִי סָלְקָא דַעְתָּךְ כְּאַבָּא שָׁאוּל סְבִירָא לֵיהּ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers רב פפא's question from step 17.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Proof from what the speaker did not say: a better argument was available and unused, so he must not hold that view.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: רבי יוסי might hold like אבא שאול, which would make רבי יוחנן's counter-proof fail.
steps.terutzMaskana: רבי יוסי holds like the חכמים, so רבי יוחנן's challenge stands.

steps.title: Spelling out the easier קל וחומר from the טבול יום
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא begins to lay out the קל וחומר רבי יוסי would have used if he held like אבא שאול.
steps.simpleTranslation: Food that became impure through a טבול יום comes from someone who is himself allowed to eat חולין, and still you say it makes a רביעי in קודש. Then food...
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא is building the 'easier' קל וחומר that רבי יוסי could have used. It states the first half here, and the sentence continues on the next amud.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The starting point is weak: a טבול יום is so mildly impure that he may still eat חולין. Yet according to אבא שאול, food he touches still makes a רביעי in קודש. The other half of the comparison begins with the word אוכל and finishes on the next amud.

keyTerms.meaning: And just as, the opening of a קל וחומר
Himself, his own body
Permitted to eat ordinary, non-sacred food
You say, meaning you still rule

phrases.aramaic: וּמָה אוֹכֶל הַבָּא מֵחֲמַת טְבוּל יוֹם,
phrases.english: And just as food that became impure through one who immersed that day,
where the one who immersed that day is himself permitted to eat non-sacred food
you still say it makes a fourth degree in sacred food,
then food...

steps.triggerLanguage: וּמָה אוֹכֶל הַבָּא מֵחֲמַת טְבוּל יוֹם
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Spells out the alternative קל וחומר that step 18 says רבי יוסי would have used.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Showing the stronger argument that was available, to prove רבי יוסי did not hold like אבא שאול.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: Perhaps רבי יוסי's קל וחומר assumes אבא שאול's view.
steps.terutzMaskana: Under אבא שאול's view an easier קל וחומר exists, and רבי יוסי did not use it.
